question: Can the frozen sentence encoders from the text task transfer useful distinctions between values in an anonymous categorical table? Compare intfloat/e5-small-v2 and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 against the same internal evidence without downloading task data.
representation: Discover recurring and varying fields from fitting features only. Serialize each block as neutral numbered fields and values. Use the existing verified, offline E5 and BGE loaders and their published pooling rules. Fit PCA on training vectors only, 16 components per block. Query vectors never update the representation. Compare one recurring-context CatBoost head augmented with dense block components and one L2 logistic head on standardized block components, cross-products and sparse profile/context key indicators per encoder.
election: Four supervised heads total. Freeze all probability matrices before reading the 808 nomination answers. Rank shares 0, .125, .25, .5 or 1 against the established research pair. Freeze one winner before the 817 / 807 checks. A pooled gain of .003 with nonnegative effects on both leads to an ordinary-entry validation study. These three panels have been reused. No new course or formal test scores and no language-model API.
